versions.content: Mapping of CompositionSwComponentType In case a mapped SwComponentPrototype refers to a CompositionSwComponentType , the mapping is applied to any inner SwComponentPrototype recursively; however, it may be overwritten by additional SwcToEcuMapping mapping inner SwComponent- Prototype to different EcuInstance s.
